description: This file defines the PrismaAgentRepository class, which manages database operations related to agents, including access control, retrieval, creation, updating, and linking agents to workflows, with specific focus on user and team permissions.

classes.name: PrismaAgentRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing agent data with access control, retrieval, creation, and update methods.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleTeamIds
methods.description: Retrieves team IDs the user has access to.

methods.name: getUserAdminTeamIds
methods.description: Retrieves team IDs where the user has admin or owner roles.

methods.name: findByIdWithUserAccess
methods.description: Finds an agent by ID with user access considerations.

methods.name: findByProviderAgentIdWithUserAccess
methods.description: Finds an agent by provider agent ID with user access considerations.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an agent by its unique ID.

methods.name: findByProviderAgentId
methods.description: Finds an agent by provider agent ID.

methods.name: findManyWithUserAccess
methods.description: Retrieves multiple agents accessible to the user, with scope options.

methods.name: findByIdWithUserAccessAndDetails
methods.description: Finds an agent with detailed info and user access control.

methods.name: findByIdWithAdminAccess
methods.description: Finds an agent with admin access control.

methods.name: findByIdWithCallAccess
methods.description: Finds an agent with call access control.

methods.name: linkOutboundAgentToWorkflow
methods.description: Links an outbound agent to a workflow step.

methods.name: linkInboundAgentToWorkflow
methods.description: Links an inbound agent to a workflow step.

methods.name: updateEventTypeId
methods.description: Updates inbound event type ID for an agent.

methods.name: updateOutboundEventTypeId
methods.description: Updates outbound event type ID for an agent.

methods.name: canManageTeamResources
methods.description: Checks if a user has admin or owner role in a team.

methods.name: findAgentWithPhoneNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves an agent along with its associated phone numbers.

methods.name: findProviderAgentIdById
methods.description: Retrieves the provider agent ID for a given agent.
